name: Cadence
author: Jim Merioles
description: Cadence is a focused workday system for the Omarchy bar: a Deep Focus and Short Focus timer with automatic Do Not Disturb, building toward timeboxing and decision tools.

barWidget.description: Focus + Attention, the first Cadence wedge: Deep Focus and Short Focus sessions, automatic Do Not Disturb, breaks, and notification replay. Timeboxing and decision tools are next.

schema.label: Deep Focus length (minutes)
schema.description: Ultradian method. The standard is 90 minutes.

schema.label: Short Focus length (minutes)
schema.description: Pomodoro method. A short focus block for smaller tasks.

schema.label: Deep Focus break (minutes)
schema.description: Recovery after a Deep Focus block.

schema.label: Short Focus break (minutes)
schema.description: Short recovery after a Short Focus block.

schema.label: Start breaks automatically
schema.description: Begin the break countdown as soon as a work session ends.

schema.label: Start work automatically
schema.description: Begin the next work session as soon as a break ends.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify when a work or break session ends.
